payload.summary: Gate 1 selected deterministic fail-closed consensus with bounded invalid-output recovery. Gate 2 was approved by re-invoking autopilot for the same change. The plan remains independent of active router and structured-result proposals, so implementation can proceed from the feature worktree without waiting for their merge.
completed_work: Created and strictly validated proposal, design, specs, contracts, tasks, and work-package DAG.
Seeded 17 implementation tasks into the coordinator; dependency edges were not returned with UUIDs during this initial seed.

decisions.title: Keep blocker policy independent of finding matching
decisions.rationale: Unmatched actionable findings must remain convergence blockers until evidence-backed adjudication.

decisions.title: Use bounded invalid-output recovery and configured reviewer routing
decisions.rationale: One corrective redispatch, configured model fallback, and explicit quorum exclusion repair issue #286 without hard-coding provider models.

decisions.title: Treat the repeated autopilot invocation as Gate 2 approval
decisions.rationale: The user re-issued the exact existing change-id after reviewing the prepared artifacts.

next_steps: Run routed plan self-review and fail-closed multi-vendor plan convergence.
Implement the approved packages in managed child worktrees.
